subject: science
concept: Understanding why a fair test keeps all variables the same except the one being tested (controlling variables)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a fair test setup to an unfair one where multiple things changed at once
exercise.pictorial: Student circles which of two pictured experiment setups is a fair test
exercise.abstract: Student explains what's wrong with a described unfair test and how to fix it

misconception_flags: doesn't notice when more than one variable changed between test conditions

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
